title: त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 30 · The Pandavas find Duryodhana in the lake

summary.en: The Pandavas, led by Krishna, come to the lake and call to Duryodhana to come out and fight. He answers from the water, and Yudhishthira taunts him for hiding, offering him the kingdom if he can win.
summary.kn: ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ನೇತೃತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಂಡವರು ಸರೋವರಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನನ್ನು ಹೋರಾಡಲು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ನೀರಿನಿಂದಲೇ ಅವನು ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅಡಗಿದ್ದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಹೀಯಾಳಿಸಿ ಗೆದ್ದರೆ ರಾಜ್ಯ ನೀಡುವೆನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: कृष्ण के नेतृत्व में पाण्डव सरोवर पर आकर दुर्योधन को बाहर निकलकर लड़ने को पुकारते हैं। वह जल से उत्तर देता है, और युधिष्ठिर छिपने पर ताना मारकर कहते हैं कि जीते तो राज्य उसका होगा।
summary.te: కృష్ణుని నాయకత్వంలో పాండవులు సరస్సు వద్దకు వచ్చి బయటికి వచ్చి పోరాడమని దుర్యోధనుని పిలుస్తారు. అతడు నీటిలోంచే బదులిస్తాడు; దాక్కున్నందుకు యుధిష్ఠిరుడు ఎగతాళి చేసి గెలిస్తే రాజ్యం ఇస్తానంటాడు.
summary.ta: கண்ணன் தலைமையில் பாண்டவர் குளத்தருகே வந்து துரியோதனனை வெளியே வந்து போரிடக் கூவ, அவன் நீரிலிருந்தே பதிலளிக்கிறான். ஒளிந்ததற்காக யுதிஷ்டிரர் இகழ்ந்து, வென்றால் நாட்டை உனதாக்குவேன் என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: കൃഷ്ണന്റെ നേതൃത്വത്തിൽ പാണ്ഡവർ തടാകത്തിന്റെ അരികിലെത്തി, പുറത്തുവന്ന് പൊരുതാൻ ദുര്യോധനനെ വിളിക്കുന്നു. വെള്ളത്തിനുള്ളിൽനിന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം മറുപടി പറയുന്നു; ഒളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതിനെ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ പരിഹസിക്കുകയും, ജയിച്ചാൽ രാജ്യം നൽകാമെന്ന് വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.30; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततस्तेष्वपयातेषु रथेषु त्रिषु पाण्डवाः ।
तं ह्रदं प्रत्यपद्यन्त यत्र दुर्योधनोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: When those three chariot-fighters had gone away, the Pandavas reached the lake where Duryodhana was.

verses.text:
आसाद्य च कुरुश्रेष्ठ तदा द्वैपायनह्रदम् ।
स्तम्भितं धार्तराष्ट्रेण दृष्ट्वा तं सलिलाशयम् ।
वासुदेवमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत्कुरुनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the Dvaipayana lake, O best of the Kurus, and seeing that pool stilled by the Dhartarashtra, the delight of the Kurus spoke these words to Vasudeva:

verses.text:
पश्येमां धार्तराष्ट्रेण मायामप्सु प्रयोजिताम् ।
विष्टभ्य सलिलं शेते नास्य मानुषतो भयम् ॥

meaning.en: "Look at this illusion the Dhartarashtra has worked in the water. He lies with the water stilled, and has no fear from any man.

verses.text:
दैवीं मायामिमां कृत्वा सलिलान्तर्गतो ह्ययम् ।
निकृत्या निकृतिप्रज्ञो न मे जीवन्विमोक्ष्यते ॥

meaning.en: Having made this divine illusion, he has gone into the water, a deceiver with a deceiver's mind; he will not escape me alive.

verses.text:
यद्यस्य समरे साह्यं कुरुते वज्रभृत्स्वयम् ।
तथाप्येनं हतं युद्धे लोको द्रक्ष्यति माधव ॥

meaning.en: Even if the wielder of the thunderbolt himself were to help him in the battle, Madhava, the world will still see him slain in the fight."

verses.text: श्रीवासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Shri Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
मायाविन इमां मायां मायया जहि भारत ।
मायावी मायया वध्यः सत्यमेतद्युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: "Destroy this illusion of the illusionist by illusion, O Bharata. The illusionist must be killed by illusion; this is true, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
क्रियाभ्युपायैर्बहुलैर्मायामप्सु प्रयोज्य ह ।
जहि त्वं भरतश्रेष्ठ पापात्मानं सुयोधनम् ॥

meaning.en: Use many contrivances of action and work your own illusion on the water, O best of the Bharatas, and kill the evil-souled Suyodhana.

verses.text:
क्रियाभ्युपायैरिन्द्रेण निहता दैत्यदानवाः ।
क्रियाभ्युपायैर्बहुभिर्बलिर्बद्धो महात्मना ॥

meaning.en: By contrivances of action Indra killed the Daityas and Danavas; by many contrivances of action Bali was bound by the great-souled one.

verses.text:
क्रियाभ्युपायैः पूर्वं हि हिरण्याक्षो महासुरः ।
हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव क्रिययैव निषूदितौ ।
वृत्रश्च निहतो राजन्क्रिययैव न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: By contrivances of action, long ago, the great asura Hiranyaksha and Hiranyakashipu were slain, and Vritra was killed, O king, by contrivance alone, without doubt.

verses.text:
तथा पौलस्त्यतनयो रावणो नाम राक्षसः ।
रामेण निहतो राजन्सानुबन्धः सहानुगः ।
क्रियया योगमास्थाय तथा त्वमपि विक्रम ॥

meaning.en: So too the rakshasa Ravana, son of Pulastya's line, was killed by Rama with his kin and followers, O king, by action joined with skill; do you too show your valor.

verses.text:
क्रियाभ्युपायैर्निहतो मया राजन्पुरातने ।
तारकश्च महादैत्यो विप्रचित्तिश्च वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: By contrivances of action I myself, O king, in ancient times killed the great Daitya Taraka and the mighty Viprachitti,

verses.text:
वातापिरिल्वलश्चैव त्रिशिराश्च तथा विभो ।
सुन्दोपसुन्दावसुरौ क्रिययैव निषूदितौ ॥

meaning.en: Vatapi, Ilvala and Trishiras, O lord, and the asuras Sunda and Upasunda were slain by contrivance alone.

verses.text:
क्रियाभ्युपायैरिन्द्रेण त्रिदिवं भुज्यते विभो ।
क्रिया बलवती राजन्नान्यत्किंचिद्युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: By contrivances of action Indra enjoys heaven, O lord. Contrivance is powerful, O king; nothing else is, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
दैत्याश्च दानवाश्चैव राक्षसाः पार्थिवास्तथा ।
क्रियाभ्युपायैर्निहताः क्रियां तस्मात्समाचर ॥

meaning.en: Daityas, Danavas, rakshasas and kings were killed by contrivances of action; therefore make use of contrivance."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन पाण्डवः संशितव्रतः ।
जलस्थं तं महाराज तव पुत्रं महाबलम् ।
अभ्यभाषत कौन्तेयः प्रहसन्निव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed by Vasudeva, the Pandava of firm vows, Kunti's son, spoke to your mighty son as he lay in the water, as if smiling, O Bharata.

verses.text:
सुयोधन किमर्थोऽयमारम्भोऽप्सु कृतस्त्वया ।
सर्वं क्षत्रं घातयित्वा स्वकुलं च विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: "Suyodhana, why have you made this scheme in the water, having had the whole warrior class and your own family killed, O lord of the people?

verses.text:
जलाशयं प्रविष्टोऽद्य वाञ्छञ्जीवितमात्मनः ।
उत्तिष्ठ राजन्युध्यस्व सहास्माभिः सुयोधन ॥

meaning.en: You have entered the water today wishing to save your own life. Rise, O king, and fight us, Suyodhana.

verses.text:
स च दर्पो नरश्रेष्ठ स च मानः क्व ते गतः ।
यस्त्वं संस्तभ्य सलिलं भीतो राजन्व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Where has that pride gone, O best of men, and that self-regard, that you stand here frightened with the water stilled?

verses.text:
सर्वे त्वां शूर इत्येव जना जल्पन्ति संसदि ।
व्यर्थं तद्भवतो मन्ये शौर्यं सलिलशायिनः ॥

meaning.en: All people in the assembly call you a hero, but I think your heroism is empty, lying in the water.

verses.text:
उत्तिष्ठ राजन्युध्यस्व क्षत्रियोऽसि कुलोद्भवः ।
कौरवेयो विशेषेण कुले जन्म च संस्मर ॥

meaning.en: Rise, O king, and fight; you are a kshatriya, born of a noble house, and a Kaurava especially. Remember your birth in this family.

verses.text:
स कथं कौरवे वंशे प्रशंसञ्जन्म चात्मनः ।
युद्धाद्भीतस्ततस्तोयं प्रविश्य प्रतितिष्ठसि ॥

meaning.en: How can you, praising your own birth in the Kaurava line, frightened of battle, enter the water and stay there?

verses.text:
अयुद्धमव्यवस्थानं नैष धर्मः सनातनः ।
अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यं रणे राजन्पलायनम् ॥

meaning.en: Not fighting, not holding your ground: this is not the eternal dharma. Flight from battle, O king, is practiced by the ignoble and does not lead to heaven.

verses.text:
कथं पारमगत्वा हि युद्धे त्वं वै जिजीविषुः ।
इमान्निपतितान्दृष्ट्वा पुत्रान्भ्रातॄन्पितॄंस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: How can you, wishing to live without reaching the end of the battle, after seeing these sons, brothers and fathers fallen,

verses.text:
संबन्धिनो वयस्यांश्च मातुलान्बान्धवांस्तथा ।
घातयित्वा कथं तात ह्रदे तिष्ठसि सांप्रतम् ॥

meaning.en: and after having your relatives, friends, maternal uncles and kinsmen killed, stay in the lake now, dear one?

verses.text:
शूरमानी न शूरस्त्वं मिथ्या वदसि भारत ।
शूरोऽहमिति दुर्बुद्धे सर्वलोकस्य शृण्वतः ॥

meaning.en: You think yourself a hero but are not one; you speak falsely, Bharata, when you declare, in the hearing of the whole world, 'I am a hero,' you fool.

verses.text:
न हि शूराः पलायन्ते शत्रून्दृष्ट्वा कथंचन ।
ब्रूहि वा त्वं यया धृत्या शूर त्यजसि संगरम् ॥

meaning.en: Heroes never run away on seeing their enemies. Or tell me, hero, with what resolve you abandon the fight.

verses.text:
स त्वमुत्तिष्ठ युध्यस्व विनीय भयमात्मनः ।
घातयित्वा सर्वसैन्यं भ्रातॄंश्चैव सुयोधन ॥

meaning.en: So rise and fight, putting aside your fear, Suyodhana, having had your whole army and your brothers killed.

verses.text:
नेदानीं जीविते बुद्धिः कार्या धर्मचिकीर्षया ।
क्षत्रधर्ममपाश्रित्य त्वद्विधेन सुयोधन ॥

meaning.en: Now is no time to think about preserving life from a wish to follow dharma, Suyodhana, for a man like you who has taken refuge in the kshatriya's dharma.

verses.text:
यत्तत्कर्णमुपाश्रित्य शकुनिं चापि सौबलम् ।
अमर्त्य इव संमोहात्त्वमात्मानं न बुद्धवान् ॥

meaning.en: Because you relied on Karna and on Shakuni son of Subala, you did not know yourself, as if deluded into thinking you were immortal.

verses.text:
तत्पापं सुमहत्कृत्वा प्रतियुध्यस्व भारत ।
कथं हि त्वद्विधो मोहाद्रोचयेत पलायनम् ॥

meaning.en: Having done that great wrong, fight back, Bharata. How could a man like you, in delusion, favor running away?

verses.text:
क्व ते तत्पौरुषं यातं क्व च मानः सुयोधन ।
क्व च विक्रान्तता याता क्व च विस्फूर्जितं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Where has your manliness gone, and your self-respect, Suyodhana? Where has your valor gone, and your great roaring?

verses.text:
क्व ते कृतास्त्रता याता किं च शेषे जलाशये ।
स त्वमुत्तिष्ठ युध्यस्व क्षत्रधर्मेण भारत ॥

meaning.en: Where has your skill in weapons gone, and why do you lie in a pool? So rise and fight by the dharma of a kshatriya, Bharata.

verses.text:
अस्मान्वा त्वं पराजित्य प्रशाधि पृथिवीमिमाम् ।
अथ वा निहतोऽस्माभिर्भूमौ स्वप्स्यसि भारत ॥

meaning.en: Either defeat us and rule this earth, or be killed by us and sleep on the ground, Bharata.

verses.text:
एष ते प्रथमो धर्मः सृष्टो धात्रा महात्मना ।
तं कुरुष्व यथातथ्यं राजा भव महारथ ॥

meaning.en: This is your first duty, set by the great-souled creator. Do it as it should be done, great chariot-fighter, and be a king."

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
नैतच्चित्रं महाराज यद्भीः प्राणिनमाविशेत् ।
न च प्राणभयाद्भीतो व्यपयातोऽस्मि भारत ॥

meaning.en: "It is no wonder, great king, that fear enters a living being, and I have not run from fear for my life, Bharata.

verses.text:
अरथश्चानिषङ्गी च निहतः पार्ष्णिसारथिः ।
एकश्चाप्यगणः संख्ये प्रत्याश्वासमरोचयम् ॥

meaning.en: Chariotless, without a quiver, my rear charioteer killed, alone and without followers in the battle, I wanted a rest.

verses.text:
न प्राणहेतोर्न भयान्न विषादाद्विशां पते ।
इदमम्भः प्रविष्टोऽस्मि श्रमात्त्विदमनुष्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: Not for my life's sake, not from fear, not from despair, O lord of the people, have I entered this water; I did it from weariness.

verses.text:
त्वं चाश्वसिहि कौन्तेय ये चाप्यनुगतास्तव ।
अहमुत्थाय वः सर्वान्प्रतियोत्स्यामि संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: You too, Kunti's son, take rest, and those who follow you. I will rise and face you all in battle."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
आश्वस्ता एव सर्वे स्म चिरं त्वां मृगयामहे ।
तदिदानीं समुत्तिष्ठ युध्यस्वेह सुयोधन ॥

meaning.en: "We are all rested already; we have been looking for you for a long time. So rise now, Suyodhana, and fight here.

verses.text:
हत्वा वा समरे पार्थान्स्फीतं राज्यमवाप्नुहि ।
निहतो वा रणेऽस्माभिर्वीरलोकमवाप्स्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Either kill the Parthas in battle and gain a flourishing kingdom, or be killed by us in the battle and gain the world of heroes."

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
यदर्थं राज्यमिच्छामि कुरूणां कुरुनन्दन ।
त इमे निहताः सर्वे भ्रातरो मे जनेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: "Those for whose sake I wanted the kingdom of the Kurus, O delight of the Kurus, all those brothers of mine are dead, O lord.

verses.text:
क्षीणरत्नां च पृथिवीं हतक्षत्रियपुंगवाम् ।
नाभ्युत्सहाम्यहं भोक्तुं विधवामिव योषितम् ॥

meaning.en: I cannot bear to enjoy an earth whose jewels are spent and whose best kshatriyas are slain, like a widowed woman.

verses.text:
अद्यापि त्वहमाशंसे त्वां विजेतुं युधिष्ठिर ।
भङ्क्त्वा पाञ्चालपाण्डूनामुत्साहं भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Even now, Yudhishthira, I hope to defeat you, by breaking the spirit of the Panchalas and Pandavas, O bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
न त्विदानीमहं मन्ये कार्यं युद्धेन कर्हिचित् ।
द्रोणे कर्णे च संशान्ते निहते च पितामहे ॥

meaning.en: But now I think there is no need for battle at all, with Drona and Karna at peace in death and the grandfather slain.

verses.text:
अस्त्विदानीमियं राजन्केवला पृथिवी तव ।
असहायो हि को राजा राज्यमिच्छेत्प्रशासितुम् ॥

meaning.en: Let this earth be yours alone now, O king. What king without allies would wish to rule a kingdom?

verses.text:
सुहृदस्तादृशान्हित्वा पुत्रान्भ्रातॄन्पितॄनपि ।
भवद्भिश्च हृते राज्ये को नु जीवेत मादृशः ॥

meaning.en: Having lost friends like those, and sons, brothers and fathers, and with the kingdom taken by you, who like me would go on living?

verses.text:
अहं वनं गमिष्यामि ह्यजिनैः प्रतिवासितः ।
रतिर्हि नास्ति मे राज्ये हतपक्षस्य भारत ॥

meaning.en: I will go to the forest, clothed in deerskins; I take no pleasure in a kingdom, Bharata, with my side destroyed.

verses.text:
हतबान्धवभूयिष्ठा हताश्वा हतकुञ्जरा ।
एषा ते पृथिवी राजन्भुङ्क्ष्वैनां विगतज्वरः ॥

meaning.en: This earth, O king, with most of its kinsmen dead, its horses and elephants dead: enjoy it, free of fever.

verses.text:
वनमेव गमिष्यामि वसानो मृगचर्मणी ।
न हि मे निर्जितस्यास्ति जीवितेऽद्य स्पृहा विभो ॥

meaning.en: I will go to the forest, wearing deerskins; for I, defeated, have no wish for life today, O lord.

verses.text:
गच्छ त्वं भुङ्क्ष्व राजेन्द्र पृथिवीं निहतेश्वराम् ।
हतयोधां नष्टरत्नां क्षीणवप्रां यथासुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Go, enjoy the earth, O king of kings, whose lords are slain, whose warriors are dead, whose jewels are lost and whose ramparts are ruined, as you please."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
आर्तप्रलापान्मा तात सलिलस्थः प्रभाषथाः ।
नैतन्मनसि मे राजन्वाशितं शकुनेरिव ॥

meaning.en: "Dear one, do not speak these pitiful ravings from the water; they do not take hold in my mind, like the cries of a bird.

verses.text:
यदि चापि समर्थः स्यास्त्वं दानाय सुयोधन ।
नाहमिच्छेयमवनिं त्वया दत्तां प्रशासितुम् ॥

meaning.en: Even if you were able to give, Suyodhana, I would not wish to rule an earth given by you.

verses.text:
अधर्मेण न गृह्णीयां त्वया दत्तां महीमिमाम् ।
न हि धर्मः स्मृतो राजन्क्षत्रियस्य प्रतिग्रहः ॥

meaning.en: I would not accept this earth from you unjustly, for taking a gift is not held to be a kshatriya's dharma.

verses.text:
त्वया दत्तां न चेच्छेयं पृथिवीमखिलामहम् ।
त्वां तु युद्धे विनिर्जित्य भोक्तास्मि वसुधामिमाम् ॥

meaning.en: I do not want the whole earth given by you; I will enjoy this earth after defeating you in battle.

verses.text:
अनीश्वरश्च पृथिवीं कथं त्वं दातुमिच्छसि ।
त्वयेयं पृथिवी राजन्किं न दत्ता तदैव हि ॥

meaning.en: And how do you, who are no lord, wish to give the earth? Why did you not give it, O king, at that very time,

verses.text:
धर्मतो याचमानानां शमार्थं च कुलस्य नः ।
वार्ष्णेयं प्रथमं राजन्प्रत्याख्याय महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: when we asked for it in accord with dharma and for the sake of peace in our family, and you first refused the mighty Vrishni?

verses.text:
किमिदानीं ददासि त्वं को हि ते चित्तविभ्रमः ।
अभियुक्तस्तु को राजा दातुमिच्छेद्धि मेदिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: What do you give now, and what confusion is in your mind? What king, when attacked, would wish to give away the earth?

verses.text:
न त्वमद्य महीं दातुमीशः कौरवनन्दन ।
आच्छेत्तुं वा बलाद्राजन्स कथं दातुमिच्छसि ।
मां तु निर्जित्य संग्रामे पालयेमां वसुंधराम् ॥

meaning.en: Today you are no lord to give the earth or take it by force, O delight of the Kurus; how can you wish to give it? Defeat me in battle and rule this earth.

verses.text:
सूच्यग्रेणापि यद्भूमेरपि ध्रीयेत भारत ।
तन्मात्रमपि नो मह्यं न ददाति पुरा भवान् ॥

meaning.en: You would not give us even as much of the land as could be held on the point of a needle, in the past.

verses.text:
स कथं पृथिवीमेतां प्रददासि विशां पते ।
सूच्यग्रं नात्यजः पूर्वं स कथं त्यजसि क्षितिम् ॥

meaning.en: How then do you give this whole earth now, O lord of the people? He who did not give up a needle's point before, how does he give up the land?

verses.text:
एवमैश्वर्यमासाद्य प्रशास्य पृथिवीमिमाम् ।
को हि मूढो व्यवस्येत शत्रोर्दातुं वसुंधराम् ॥

meaning.en: Having reached such lordship and ruled this earth, what fool would resolve to give the earth to his enemy?

verses.text:
त्वं तु केवलमौर्ख्येण विमूढो नावबुध्यसे ।
पृथिवीं दातुकामोऽपि जीवितेनाद्य मोक्ष्यसे ॥

meaning.en: But you, bewildered by sheer folly, do not understand: even wishing to give the earth, you will not escape with your life today.

verses.text:
अस्मान्वा त्वं पराजित्य प्रशाधि पृथिवीमिमाम् ।
अथ वा निहतोऽस्माभिर्व्रज लोकाननुत्तमान् ॥

meaning.en: Either defeat us and rule this earth, or be killed by us and go to the highest worlds.

verses.text:
आवयोर्जीवतो राजन्मयि च त्वयि च ध्रुवम् ।
संशयः सर्वभूतानां विजये नो भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: While we two live, O king, you and I, all beings will surely be left in doubt about which of us wins.

verses.text:
जीवितं तव दुष्प्रज्ञ मयि संप्रति वर्तते ।
जीवयेयं त्वहं कामं न तु त्वं जीवितुं क्षमः ॥

meaning.en: Your life, you of poor wit, now rests with me. I could spare your life if I wished, but you are not fit to live.

verses.text:
दहने हि कृतो यत्नस्त्वयास्मासु विशेषतः ।
आशीविषैर्विषैश्चापि जले चापि प्रवेशनैः ।
त्वया विनिकृता राजन्राज्यस्य हरणेन च ॥

meaning.en: You made special efforts against us, with burning, with venomous snakes and poisons, with plunging us in water, and you cheated us, O king, by taking the kingdom.

verses.text:
एतस्मात्कारणात्पाप जीवितं ते न विद्यते ।
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ युध्यस्व तत्ते श्रेयो भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: For this reason, sinner, there is no life for you. Rise, rise, and fight; that will be better for you."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
एवं तु विविधा वाचो जययुक्ताः पुनः पुनः ।
कीर्तयन्ति स्म ते वीरास्तत्र तत्र जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: So, again and again, those heroes spoke many kinds of words, full of victory, here and there, O lord of the people.
